assumptions: THE LOOK (spec History 2026-11-13). Row look/agent-repository-held: an agent repository due at an event, with a kept worktree inside it that the list holds only by its path, is held back by the kind registry given Signal's own inside; no rule judged it, no remover was handed it, and the worktree's uncommitted file is on disk as the call returns. Falsifier space301-look-answers-nothing turns the row red. With the stub look the remover is still not reached, because rule 6 reads the same inside and refuses; the row sees the registry's layer by the outcome's rule (registry, not children). Two layers hold the repository, and the falsifier removes one.

THE OWNER'S CONFIRMATION is the item's confirmed field. No ledger command writes it until VELDO-0320, and the store refuses a write of an item by anything but the ledger's own transitions (foreign_transition, seen in this build). So ac3/report-mode has Signal read the real ledger through a view that returns one item with its confirmation; every other read and every write is the ledger's own. Signal carries out only items the event made due in this call: an item already due from an earlier call (left due in report mode, then confirmed) is not picked up by a later event, because the ledger's signal marks only present, kept and deferred items. Carrying out such a group is VELDO-0320.

ACT MODE in the suite is reached by the owner's real signed command with the two act checks standing in (VELDO-0332 and 0339 are not built and allow). Nothing in the repository installs those checks, so no scope on a real host can be in act, and on a real host Signal carries out only confirmed items, which nothing can write yet: this ticket removes nothing on a real host.

KEPT is written for an action that removes nothing: keep, measure, mark_contained, pass, an event with no cell for the item's row, and drop_caches after its remover ran. The measuring of a measure cell and the mark of a contained branch are not done here. The ledger's signal marks a kept item due again at its next event, including a worktree the owner will one day answer Keep for (VELDO-0318): nothing in this ticket tells an owner's Keep from the table's keep, because nothing writes an owner's Keep yet. The ticket that writes it must make it visible to Signal or to the ledger's signal.

Observability: the journal holds one signal record and one outcome record per carried item; the answer of signal holds outcomes and counts (removed, gone, kept, removing, left, deferred by deferral). Nothing emits these to a metrics sink; no caller of signal exists yet (the event sources are later tickets).

Rule 7's deferral in control_space_signal.rules is now the remover's own when it is remove_refused, in_use or keep_failed. Suites 137 and 138 are green with it: their rows read the rule, the passed count and said.deferral.

THE COMMIT. commit and tree name the first build (296ef369). The fix from the independent review (review-veldo-0301.md, verdict FIX) is in the commit that carries this bundle, 'VELDO-0301 and VELDO-0345: gone only when not found, every item gets an outcome, a kept ref per attempt (review)', made as one commit by the lead's instruction; a bundle cannot name the commit it is in. Everything here was run on that commit's tree.

THE ITEM IS REMOVING WHILE ITS REMOVER RUNS since VELDO-0345 (design 4.1), and the suite runs the keeper's own keep step. The two assumptions of the first build about that are no longer true and were taken out.

GONE (AC6). Not found is os.lstat's ENOENT at the locator (control_space_probe.there, through located) and at the marked name (control_space_remove.left, which raises on any other answer). The EACCES case is a real folder of mode 000; the EIO case is os.lstat replaced for one name in the suite's process, because no real disk was made to fail. ENOENT because a folder above the item is itself not there is still not found, and such an item is gone. The suite takes a folder's search permission and must not run as root.

THE CARRIER (AC8) is on outcomes this call writes. An item left due holds none: nobody holds it. The window between due and removing is not marked on the item; it is closed by the ledger's one removing write and by the loser writing nothing. What reconcile does with the carrier is VELDO-0315 AC5, not built.

ITEMS LEFT DUE (review finding 4) are not picked up by Signal at a later event. VELDO-0320 AC1 (Confirm) and VELDO-0315 AC6 (reconcile, added with this fix) carry them. Until one is built such an item stays due; nothing is removed and nothing is lost. The retry of a signal command refused as stale_version is not built.

NOT DONE HERE, each deferred safely: remove_held (evidence files a copy holds) has no remover and is deferred remove_refused; a review worktree's scratch is not removed first, so git's non-forced remove refuses it; no decision request is raised for unique work (VELDO-0318).

A DEFERRAL WRITTEN FOR AN EXCEPTION (AC7) can be written for an item that is removing. When the remover had already removed the thing and the write of removed then raised, the item is deferred with nothing at its locator, and its next event marks it gone. When the ledger cannot write the deferral either, the call's answer holds the item with no outcome and what was raised; the item stays as the ledger last recorded it.
rollback: Revert the change. No event removes anything, and items stay as recorded.
